scope: Shared story bundle directory, explicit bindings and calls, per-line dialogue and conditional choices, saved history, stable story/battle continuation

currentPolicy.finalDocsCheck: not run after final documentation synchronization

stageFull.limit: Run before subsequent session/actor/result-branch hardening and additional boundary tests; not evidence for the final tree

latestTargeted.limit: Affected story/dialogue behavior only; later source formatting and documentation synchronization were not re-tested

stageStatic.limit: Earlier source/doc stage; final Markdown and Skill synchronization did not run this check again

firstBoundaries.reason: New test source had an unmatched parenthesis; corrected in the subsequent passing targeted run

observed: Ordinary movement to Littleroot house sign
Open sign dialogue and confirm with Z
Open menu and click dialogue history; recorded house text visible

limits: Oldale gift result example omits original direction paths, map placement and music
Short legacy story battles do not automatically become durable sessions
No arbitrary return/local-frame interpreter or active battle save
No final full regression, final docs validator, new coverage collection or remote CI in the documentation/submission task
reuse: Keep these separate stage scopes; do not sum their counts or claim final-tree acceptance. Changed runtime or contracts invalidate affected evidence; defer further execution until the user resumes validation.
